about: v0.6 told cutscene (OWNER: v0.6 WP-D): the mountain of herbs (Yuddha 6.74, Vālmīki only), a 3D cutscene on the Āditya engine (cutscene3d-herbs.ts; 2D still: painter "d", cutscene-paint-d.ts) with one question that cannot fail: "Take the whole mountain!". Started by { "cutscene": "herbs" } in package C's Kathā block of ch6.kumbhakarna (onWin), right after C's verse s-mrtasanjivani (6.74.33), so this scene carries no verse. Shots: north, himalaya, search, hidden, roar, lift, sea, revive. Format: types.ts ToldCutscene; engine: logic-told.ts / view-told.tsx. Each line's source: notes/v06-d.md.
title: The mountain of herbs
source: Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Yuddha 6.74.29–31 (Jāmbavān: to the Himālaya, the herb mountain between Ṛṣabha and Kailāsa), 6.74.49–64 (the flight north; the herbs hide), 6.74.65–69 (Hanumān's words to the mountain; he tears off its peak and flies back, bright as the sun), 6.74.72–74 (the scent of the herbs: Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa and the army rise as if from sleep) — vulgate numbering (valmikiramayan.net)

steps.say: Hanuman leaps into the sky, towards the Himalaya.
Between Rishabha and Kailasa, the mountain of herbs shines.
The herbs know that he has come. They hide from him!
Mountain, have you no pity for Rama? See my strength!
He takes the whole mountain and flies back, shining like the sun.
Rama, Lakshmana and the vanaras breathe in the herbs. They rise, as if from sleep.
